title: Naturally Dense Vietnamese Lemongrass Noodles
description: A malty and dense Vietnamese dish featuring lemongrass and caramelized onions, served in an agave leaf vessel, this jain-friendly meal is perfect for a light lunch.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Add the bruised lemongrass to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the malty rice syrup, salt, and black pepper.
Combine the cooked noodles and skillet mixture in a large bowl and toss to combine.
Spoon the noodle mixture into the agave leaves and serve immediately.
Fold the agave leaves over the noodles to form a bundle and secure with a toothpick if needed.
